reviewer_role: Separate lead-model reviewer; not a participant executor. Scoring based on complete reports and supplied source passages, not a keyword matcher.

rubric.claim_coverage: A claim is covered only when the report assesses its substance and points to the correct Q locator, regardless of table/bullet format.
rubric.material_issue_detection: Credit requires the actual planted problem, including both causality and cross-team overreach for case-01 Q4 and both competing proposals plus unresolved authority for case-02 Q4/Q5.
rubric.false_material_finding: An unsupported substantive defect, false factual conclusion, or incorrect required substantive correction. Unnecessary headings or optional scope clarifications that preserve the supported fact are recorded separately as non-material defects.
rubric.source_citation_accuracy: One assessment per claim, six per report. Each cited source passage must substantiate the reported facts. Introductory source attribution may supply file identity for subsequent line-only citations. Broad accurate ranges are allowed; a locator naming the wrong line for the replacement value fails this score.
rubric.conflict_handling: Case-02 has two superseded-value claims and two unresolved proposal conflicts per run. Credit requires authority-grounded amendment use and leaving retention/capacity unresolved while identifying each proposal.
rubric.useful_correction: For each planted issue, report supplies a usable replacement fact or evidence limitation, removal/substantiation direction, or sufficiently specific correction to repair the claim from the supplied packet; a verbatim rewritten sentence is not required.
rubric.clean_control: All six supported claims preserved with no invented material defects. Style/presentation comments are scored separately.
rubric.format: Normalized dispositions, coverage introductions and tables are noted as presentation/traceability advantages, not counted as factual improvement by themselves.

acceptance.reason: Material performance and human reminders tie the current arm. Experimental has clearer explicit dispositions and avoids current correction-label defects, but adds no claim/issue/correction/conflict coverage and no citation accuracy advantage over current. It fixes checklist passage-location defects, not a material correctness failure. This evidence does not justify a new Skill or module.

recommendation.smallest_next_action: Retain current Skills. If a delivery example is wanted after the no-save continuation, reuse the explicit generic evidence checklist with the existing checklist Skill and a passage-locator check; no new Skill, module or payload migration.
recommendation.no_save_continuation: Required by the plan before retention recommendation is finalized; not scored in these 18 reports. Root lead owns its separate evidence.
recommendation.scope: This is the comparison scoring only; it does not establish PR delivery or release readiness.

limitations: Only three synthetic cases; repetitions are not independent population samples or a user study.
Cases, experimental guidance and participant reports come from the same author-model lineage; separate review does not remove this dependency.
Oracle was hidden from supplied participant packets until execution completed; native filesystem/tool-root isolation was unavailable. Enforced blinding is not claimed.
gpt-6-luna and medium are requested dispatch attribution only; effective runtime model and effort were not independently observed.
Supplied short Markdown only: no qualification of Library retrieval, PDF parsing, native discovery, installation, live documents or provider retention.
Word counts describe output length only; they are not token/cost/latency or savings measurements.
